# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
The alarm goes off, and the battle begins. Before your feet hit the floor, the enemy is already working—whispering that you can hit snooze, that today doesn't matter, that you can coast. But Paul's charge to the church in Corinth is a battle cry for every man who follows Christ: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Notice the order. Watchfulness comes first. A soldier who isn't alert gets ambushed. A man who isn't watchful over his heart, his eyes, his time, and his temper will fall—not in a dramatic collapse, but in a slow drift. Strength isn't just physical; it's moral and spiritual resolve forged in prayer and Scripture before the day's demands hit. You don't rise strong by accident. You rise strong by deciding, before the sun comes up, that today belongs to God. So stand firm. Act like men. Be strong—not in your own power, but in the One who conquered the grave.
## Daily Challenge
Before your first task today, do 25 pushups and thank God out loud for the strength to stand firm. Then read one Psalm before you touch your phone.
